items.title: Own profile — no always-visible edit form
steps: Open own profile (/u/me or /u/{username})
Confirm page shows header card + post timeline area
Confirm Edit Profile form is NOT visible by default
items.expected: Main profile surface is header + timeline; no inline edit card.
items.evidence: Screenshot 2026-07-31: profile shows header + timeline only; no inline edit form.

items.title: Edit Profile via ellipsis modal
steps: Click horizontal ellipsis (⋯) on profile header
Click Edit Profile
Confirm modal shows Full Name, Username, Bio fields
Change bio text and click Save
Confirm modal closes and bio appears in header
items.expected: Edit Profile opens modal with all three fields; save persists and updates header.
items.evidence: EditProfileDialog.tsx implements modal with Full Name, Username, Bio; wired from ProfilePage ⋯ menu.
items.notes: Save flow not re-run at finalize; implementation matches spec.

items.title: No profile picture editing UI
steps: Open Edit Profile modal from ⋯ menu
Confirm no camera button, file upload, or avatar URL field
Open ⋯ menu and confirm Remove Profile Picture is absent
items.expected: All avatar editing controls removed from profile UI.
items.evidence: ProfilePage + EditProfileDialog contain no avatar upload/URL/camera/remove controls.

items.title: Profile timeline shows own posts
items.precondition: Signed in; user has at least one post on Feed
steps: Create a post on Feed
Navigate to own profile
Confirm the post appears in timeline below header
Confirm reactions and comment link work
items.expected: User's posts appear on profile in feed-card style.
items.evidence: Screenshot 2026-07-31: post "test" from Feed visible on /u/Kylie with reaction count.

items.title: Other user's profile timeline
items.precondition: Signed in; another user with posts exists
steps: Visit another user's profile (/u/{their-username})
Confirm their posts appear below header
Confirm no Edit Profile option in ⋯ (not own profile)
Confirm no Delete on their posts
items.expected: Other profiles show read-only timeline; no edit/delete affordances for viewer.
items.waiver: Single-user local session; other-user profile not exercised. Code gates Edit Profile and Delete to own profile/post.

items.title: Delete own post from profile timeline
items.precondition: Signed in; own profile has a post
steps: On own profile, click Delete on a timeline post
Confirm delete dialog appears
Confirm deletion removes post from profile timeline
items.evidence: Delete control visible on own post in screenshot.
items.waiver: Full delete confirm flow not re-run at finalize; reuses Feed ConfirmDialog pattern.

items.title: Public preview still works
steps: Open ⋯ → View Profile
Confirm read-only header with bio visible
Confirm Edit Profile modal is not accessible
Click Back to edit and return to normal view
items.expected: ?view=public preview unchanged except edit form no longer inline.
items.waiver: Public preview (?view=public) not re-tested this session; ProfilePage preserves preview mode branch.

items.title: Profile posts API
steps: GET /api/users/{username}/posts with Authorization header
Confirm 200 and posts array
GET /api/users/nonexistent-user/posts
Confirm 404
items.expected: API returns hydrated posts for valid user; 404 for unknown username.
items.evidence: GET /api/users/Kylie/posts returned 304 during local dev; timeline populated.

items.title: Frontend typecheck + build
steps: npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
npm --prefix frontend run build
items.evidence: npm run typecheck and npm --prefix frontend run build exit 0 on 2026-07-31.
